name: Elite fun for you
ingredients_raw: [(Candied (fruits-raisins, papaya, fresh grapes, dates, cherry & fresh orange), (Fruit & vegetable peel-orange & ginger) & (nuts-cashew nuts)}, Sugar, Acidity regulator (Citric acid)], Mixed fruit jam (mixed fruit pulp (papaya, pineapple, mango, grapes, sugar, guava & banana), sugar, glucose, Thickener (Pectins), Acidity regulator (Citric acid), & Preservative (Potassium metabisulphite)}], Wheat Flour, Sugar, Edible vegetable fat (Interesterified fat), Whole Egg powder, Edible vegetable oil (rice bran oil), Glucose syrup, Humectant (Glycerol), [Emulsifier (Mono & di - glycerides of fatty acids)], Preservative (Potassium sorbate), Leavening agent (Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate), Mixed spices (cardamom, cinnamon, clove, fennel & cumin), iodized salt, Acidity regulator (Acetic acid) and Thickener (Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose).
